def process(boston_precip) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = boston_precip.copy()
    df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce')
    df = df[df['Year'].notna()].copy()
    df = df[(df['Year'] >= 2007) & (df['Year'] <= 2009)].copy()
    for col in ['Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug']:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')
    df['Region'] = 'Boston'
    return df[['Year', 'Region', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug']]

operatorProperties.code:
def process(summer_water_data) -> pd.DataFrame:
    marine = summer_water_data[summer_water_data['Beach Type Description'] == 'Marine'].copy()
    
    # Filter to Boston and Chatham only for marine beaches
    marine = marine[marine['Community'].isin(['Boston', 'Chatham'])]
    
    exceedance = marine.groupby(['Community', 'Year', 'Month']).agg(
        Total_Samples=('Violation', 'count'),
        Violations=('Violation', lambda x: (x == 'yes').sum())
    ).reset_index()
    
    exceedance['Exceedance_Rate'] = exceedance['Violations'] / exceedance['Total_Samples']
    exceedance = exceedance.rename(columns={'Community': 'Region'})
    
    return exceedance[['Region', 'Year', 'Month', 'Exceedance_Rate', 'Total_Samples', 'Violations']]

operators.customDisplayName: Calculate exceedance rates for marine beaches (Boston and Chatham only) by region, year, and month (6, 7, 8) from 2007-2009. Exceedance rate = violations / total samples for each region-year-month combination.

def process(clean_boston_precip, clean_chatham_precip, clean_amherst_precip, clean_ashburnham_precip):
    import pandas as pd
    
    # Combine all freshwater region precipitation data
    precip_data = pd.concat([
        clean_boston_precip,
        clean_chatham_precip,
        clean_amherst_precip,
        clean_ashburnham_precip
    ], ignore_index=True)
    
    # Melt to get rainfall by month
    precip_melted = precip_data.melt(
        id_vars=['Year', 'Region'],
        value_vars=['Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug'],
        var_name='Month_Name',
        value_name='Rainfall'
    )
    
    # Map month names to numbers
    month_map = {'Jun': 6, 'Jul': 7, 'Aug': 8}
    precip_melted['Month'] = precip_melted['Month_Name'].map(month_map)
    precip_melted = precip_melted[['Year', 'Region', 'Month', 'Rainfall']]
    
    return precip_melted

operators.customDisplayName: Combine and melt freshwater regions' (Boston, Chatham, Amherst, Ashburnham) precipitation data into region-year-month format with rainfall values

    precip_data = pd.concat([

    ], ignore_index=True)
    
    # Melt to get rainfall by month

    )
    
    # Map month names to numbers

def process(marine_exceedance_by_region_month, marine_rainfall_data):

    # Filter to Boston and Chatham only
    marine_filtered = marine_exceedance_by_region_month[
        marine_exceedance_by_region_month['Region'].isin(['Boston', 'Chatham'])
    ].copy()
    
    # Merge exceedance data with rainfall data
    merged = pd.merge(
        marine_filtered,
        marine_rainfall_data,
        on=['Region', 'Year', 'Month'],
        how='inner'
    )
    
    return merged
